review_description: The two installers you gave me from your site were disappointing. One didn't bother to get in touch with me at all and the other rung me to ask me a few questions. Then I never heard from them again. I waited for 4 weeks and got in touch with a few other installers in my area and went with Solar Made Easy. Within a week I had the solar hot water on which is working great. And the solar power will be installed within the next few weeks. Thank you for your 7 days of information it was a big help to me showed me a lot of things I didn't know.
